title: memory foam pillows
text: memory foam pillows. Set of two pillows.... covers are ivory... They come tightly rolled - see pics.  If you are sensitive to foam odor - these do smell like foam does.  The card enclosed recommends 8-10 hours in the full sun (I live on the Oregon Coast - rare to have that much sun these days) OR toss in dryer on low setting for 45 mins to help dissipate the odor - I did the dryer option. I don't think it made much of an impact on the odor but is definitely fluffed them quickly.  In my experience the memory foam odor does eventually dissipate.  They are firmer.  I am a side/stomach sleeper and they seem a bit too firm for my personal taste - but I actually purchased them for the sham pillows (really just for looks) - so they work well for me. They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in great condition along with other items I ordered.  Having said all that - I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: WonderSleep Premium Adjustable Loft [Queen Size 2-Pack] - Shredded Memory Foam Pillow for Home & Hotel Collection + Washable Removable Cooling Bamboo Derived Rayon Cover - 2 Pack Queen
features: [SET OF 2 Pillow] Adjusted Comfort - Wondersleep’s pillow features shredded memory foam filling that provides therapeutic relief for all sleepers. Add and/or remove foam filling to find the perfect comfort level and enjoy a personalized sleep experience.

Safe and Sound - Featuring premium fabric to ensure your pillow stays cool and luxurious through the night. The pillow is made from 100% shredded memory foam, providing personalized support to your head, neck and shoulders, relieving pain and enhancing your sleep.

Quality Materials - The pillow is wrapped in a breathable cover made up of 40% Viscose Rayon (via Bamboo) and 60% Polyester. It is dust resistant to provide users with undisturbed slumber. Also, the zippered cover and pillow are both machine washable.

Easy to Use - To decrease firmness of pillow, remove foam filling and adjust to your sleeping comfort. To increase firmness of pillow, add additional foam filling Or fluff pillow and redistribute the filling.
Recommended Care - To maintain firmness of the memory foam pillow, tumble dry in low heat once every 6 months.
description: WonderSleep Shredded Memory Foam Pillow For Home & Hotel Collection

[Set of 2 Pillows] Wondersleep’s pillow features shredded memory foam filling that provides therapeutic relief for all sleepers. Add and/or remove foam filling to find the perfect comfort level and enjoy a personalized sleep experience.

Featuring premium fabric to ensure your pillow stays cool and luxurious through the night. The pillow is made from 80% shredded memory foam and 20% polyester-fiber, providing personalized support to your head, neck and shoulders, relieving pain and enhancing your sleep.

The pillow is wrapped in a breathable cover made up of 40% Viscose Rayon (via Bamboo) and 60% Polyester. It is dust resistant to provide users with undisturbed slumber. Also, the zippered cover and pillow are both machine washable.
To decrease firmness of pillow, remove foam filling and adjust to your sleeping comfort. To increase firmness of pillow, add additional foam filling or fluff pillow and redistribute the filling.
Note: Here are some tips to help the odor disappears more quickly

1. Separate outer pillowcase from the inner pillow and use machine wash cold and liquid detergents if needed; Do Not use bleach. 2. Resting the inner case/pillow under the sunshine and open areas to release the smell.  3. And/or Open your window and lean that pillow against the window screen, changing sides periodically
